about: Real Kannada OCR output (two independent reads) of three pages of a printed Taittiriya Udaka Shanti book. Mantra verse blocks only. Counts are of the raw files.

rules.gum: In Sanskrit (lang sa) lines, both the printed forms ಗ್ಂ and ಗ್ಗ್ಂ stand for one U+A8F3 (ꣳ). The proofread Devanagari edition writes the p0064 word ಪರಿ॒ಷ॑ದ್ಯಗ್ಗ್ಂ as परि॒षद्यꣳ॑.
rules.u0331: U+0331 is a Latin mark, not a Vedic svara. It must be flagged, never silently kept or replaced.
rules.cross_read: p0005 read1 and read2 disagree on svaras in the Ganapati mantra (read1 क॑विं, read2 क॒विं; the printed page has क॒विं). After conversion to Devanagari, those lines must get reader_disagreement.
